blocks.raw: The Modulr Portal is a great tool to use during development (it's connected to your Sandbox API account) and can be used to give your end-users secure access to their Modulr eMoney accounts and to perform actions that your integration doesn't support (depending on your integration and partnership model). They can make and receive payments, manage approvals and view payment statuses in real time. They can also set up notifications and manage other users as well as take advantage of many other features.
